scope.summary: Run the standalone exaggerated-proportion collision go/no-go twice and prove deterministic solver-native penetration, self-intersection, layer-spacing, and failure metrics before kernel validation integration.
acceptance_criteria: A fitted bodice drapes over the pinned exaggerated-proportion proxy fixture using only standalone tailor-solver contracts and produces explicit penetration, self-intersection, interlayer-spacing, convergence, contact-buffer, and accepted-step metrics.
Both deterministic runs remain inside the signed metric envelopes; overflow, truncation, initial infeasibility, untangle-budget exhaustion, NaN, or missing exact-triangle evidence fail the go/no-go.
The test has no handshake_core dependency. MT-109..113 later prove product binding and ValidationDescriptor projection from the same typed solver result.
scope.risk_if_missed: Without an exaggerated-proportion proof, the headline use case silently regresses.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-UI scope: behavior remains observable through typed Tailor state, receipts, captures, diagnostics, and TraceProjection; GUI projection is verified by the owning native-shell MT.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: The implementing MT must emit or project its applicable Tailor lifecycle, command, job, validation, or authority event through the shared Flight Recorder contract; pure solver kernels surface typed receipts through their owning run.
The shared internal_diagnostics substrate is supplied by WP-KERNEL-012/WP-KERNEL-016; this MT must use its open projection contract when available and must not fork a Tailor-only diagnostics runtime.
The shared Palmistry watcher is supplied by WP-KERNEL-012/WP-KERNEL-016; long-running Tailor jobs inherit bounded child-stall and survivor coverage during the retrofit.

required_changes_before_execution: Upgrade collision from particle/proxy pushout to mesh VF/EE predictive contact, coupled layers, SDF freshness, independent triangle validation, explicit untangle, and adversarial reliability matrices while retaining analytic preview colliders and the exaggerated-body test intent.
Added gui_obligation, user_manual_obligation, and HBR-INT-009 tier obligations from the current MT template without removing original scope.
